name: Kneeling Shoulder Retraction
summary: Kneeling facing the straps with long arms by the hips, the arms press a little behind the body as the shoulder blades draw together.
steps: Kneel facing the straps, knees behind the shoulder rests, sitting on the heels, spine tall.
Hold the short loops, arms straight beside the hips.
Breathe out to take the arms just behind the hips, shoulder blades gliding in.
Breathe in to return to the hip line.

cautions.note: Sit on the long box or with legs through the shoulder rests.

cues:
Hands never drift in front of the hips, so the ropes stay taut.
Glide the shoulder blades — don't pinch them.
Long neck, soft shoulders.
No rocking the body for momentum.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Sit on the long box, or sit cross-legged, for sore knees
Hold the long loops for less resistance
